determinism: statuses, codes and counts are deterministic; fields named wall_clock_ms_NOT_DETERMINISTIC are one measured run on one machine and vary
label: SYNTHETIC DATA / SIMULATED OPERATION / NOT PRODUCTION DEPLOYED. Fault injection against a local PostgreSQL (pgserver or a CI service container) and an in-process agent.

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: App starts degraded: /healthz 200; /readyz 503 with failed=[db, schema]; DB-backed routes 503 DB_UNAVAILABLE or DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED with Retry-After; routes that do not need the database (read tools) still answer 200; after the database returns /readyz becomes 200 without a restart. With require_db_at_start=true the process refuses to start.
scenarios.scenario: database unavailable at start

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: The connection dies after the agent started the run but before the row is written: 503 (DB_UNAVAILABLE), no runs row, no idempotency row, one orphan agent run. The breaker then opens (fast 503 without waiting). After recovery the SAME Idempotency-Key succeeds with reconciled=true and the agent still has exactly one run for the event.
scenarios.scenario: database lost mid-request (between agent effect and DB write)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: A statement slower than db_statement_timeout_ms is cancelled by PostgreSQL: 504 DB_TIMEOUT, advised retry only with the same key. When every pooled connection is busy the next request waits at most db_pool_timeout_s then gets 503 DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED with Retry-After. Afterwards the pool is healthy: the next normal request is 200 and no connection stays in 'idle in transaction'.
scenarios.scenario: slow database: statement timeout and pool timeout

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: With 0.8 s added to every database packet and a 1 s request deadline, a DB-backed request returns 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED (or 503) within about 2 s instead of hanging; with the delay removed requests succeed again.
scenarios.scenario: slow network to the database (added latency)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: No/garbage/forged token: 401 AUTH_REQUIRED or AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN; expired token: 401 AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED; zero database connections used and zero rows written for all of them.
scenarios.scenario: invalid authentication

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: No/garbage/forged token: 401 AUTH_REQUIRED or AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN; expired token: 401 AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED; zero database connections used and zero rows written for all of them.
scenarios.scenario: expired authentication

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: Capacity 5 per principal and no refill: of 10 calls by one principal exactly 5 succeed and 5 are 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After; a second principal is unaffected; per-IP capacity 8: of 12 unauthenticated calls exactly 8 reach auth (401) and 4 are 429; probes /healthz and /readyz are never limited; after the clock advances 10 s the principal can call again.

observed.note: first 7 calls consume the IP bucket; principal calls use their own bucket (5)

scenarios.scenario: rate limit exceeded

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: 20 concurrent identical requests with one Idempotency-Key: all 201 with the identical body, 19 marked Idempotent-Replay, exactly 1 runs row, 1 agent run, 1 audit row. Same key + different body: 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
scenarios.scenario: duplicate request (idempotency)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: query_inventory is SAFE_TO_RETRY, so a timing-out tool is attempted 3 times (policy max_attempts) and then returns 504 TOOL_TIMEOUT with attempts=3 and policy_actions [RETRY, RETRY, ...]; the total stays within the request deadline; a mutating route is never retried by this path.
scenarios.scenario: tool timeout

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: A tool that always raises (upstream 500): 502 UPSTREAM_FAILURE after 3 attempts; consecutive failures open the per-tool circuit breaker, after which calls fail fast with 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE and ZERO attempts; a transient fault that clears after 2 failures is absorbed (200 with attempts=3); the retry budget is respected.
scenarios.scenario: upstream 500 (retry, breaker, recovery)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: Truncated JSON, invalid UTF-8, wrong types, unknown fields, NUL bytes, wrong media type, oversize body: only 4xx envelopes (400/413/415/422); zero rows written; the agent was never called.
scenarios.scenario: malformed payloads

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: Database migrated only to version 1 (app needs 3): /readyz 503 SCHEMA_MISMATCH naming SCHEMA_OLDER; a DB-backed request returns 503 SCHEMA_MISMATCH (never a 500 with SQL details) if the missing objects are hit; after the migration job runs the app becomes ready without restart.
scenarios.scenario: schema drift: database older than the app

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: Database migrated beyond the build (extra additive migration 4): /readyz 503 SCHEMA_MISMATCH naming SCHEMA_NEWER; with allow_newer_schema=true (explicit rollback-compat switch) the same build is ready and serves requests.
scenarios.scenario: schema drift: database newer than the app

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: The audit insert (second write of the start transaction) fails after the runs insert: neither row, nor the idempotency row, exists; the response is a 5xx envelope; a retry with the same key then succeeds once.
scenarios.scenario: partial transaction: crash between two writes

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: The approval executes in the agent, then the database write fails: 500 DECISION_AMBIGUOUS (not a silent success), the transaction rolls back (no approvals row, run still awaiting in the DB), a dead letter (HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED) is stored; retrying with the SAME key returns 409 CONFLICT_STATE 'reconciled', syncs the run row to the agent state and does NOT execute the approval again.
scenarios.scenario: partial transaction: effect executed, record failed

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: If the database is down when the ambiguity is detected, the dead letter goes to the local JSONL spool (never lost, never fabricated as success); once the database is back /readyz replays the spool into dead_letters (keyed by dl_id, so replay is idempotent) and the spool file is retired.
scenarios.scenario: dead letter while the database is down (spool and replay)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: A migration whose 2nd statement fails is rolled back completely (table and version unchanged), the migration CLI exits non-zero with a clear message, and an app already running against the old schema keeps reporting its real state: the build that needs the new schema is not ready (SCHEMA_OLDER), nothing is half-applied.
scenarios.scenario: migration failure

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: Bad values, missing secrets, weak keys, unknown (typo) settings, unreadable secret files: ConfigError / process exit 78 within one call; the message names the setting and reason and never contains a secret.
scenarios.scenario: configuration error

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: A NUL byte in a decision note is rejected at validation (422 INVALID_REQUEST) before the agent is resumed: the run stays awaiting in both the agent and the database, no dead letter is created.
scenarios.scenario: NUL byte in free text

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: The agent step takes 1.2 s but the route deadline is 0.6 s: the client gets 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED (advice: retry with the same key); the worker is told to stop, so when it finishes the transaction ROLLS BACK (no runs row, no idempotency row); the SAME key then succeeds with reconciled=true and the agent has exactly one run for the event.
scenarios.scenario: request deadline exceeded mid-work (cancellation and rollback)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: One worker thread, three concurrent starts for different events, each agent step 1.0 s, deadline 1.5 s: one request completes (201); the other two answer 504 within the deadline; the queued one is cancelled before it starts so it creates NO agent run (agent runs = 2: one recorded, one executed-but-rolled-back), runs rows = 1.
scenarios.scenario: worker pool saturation (queued work is cancelled, not run late)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: With a real uvicorn server: SIGTERM-equivalent (should_exit) while a 1 s request is in flight -> that request still returns 200; the lifespan shutdown drains (readiness 503 SHUTTING_DOWN for probes during the drain), waits for in-flight=0 and closes the pool; the server thread exits within shutdown_grace_s.
scenarios.scenario: graceful shutdown with an in-flight request

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: While the database is unreachable /healthz is 200 and /metrics (OPERATOR token) is still 200 with nasha_db_up 0; after recovery nasha_db_up is 1. Operators can see the outage in the metrics that the outage affects.
scenarios.scenario: metrics and liveness during a database outage

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: Expired idempotency rows do not accumulate: after their expiry passes, the maintenance task removes them (count returns to 0) while unexpired rows remain.
scenarios.scenario: idempotency table grows without bound (expired keys never deleted)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: With maintenance_interval_s=0.5 an expired idempotency row disappears by itself within a few seconds, and the task stops at shutdown without error.
scenarios.scenario: background maintenance purges expired idempotency keys

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: Requests with arbitrary (attacker-chosen) HTTP method tokens produce at most one extra metric series ('OTHER'), not one series per distinct method.
scenarios.scenario: metric label cardinality (method)

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: GET /v1/events/ (trailing slash) without a token answers the 404 route envelope, never a 307 redirect that skips the error contract.
scenarios.scenario: trailing-slash redirect outside the error contract

scenarios.expected_stated_before_running: The public /readyz body (healthy and unhealthy) contains no schema version numbers, database codes or exception names: only per-check ok flags and coarse words.
scenarios.scenario: readiness information disclosure
